Across datasets and architectures, we find locality declines before withdrawability collapses: cue-induced information becomes less concentrated at its original support while its effect remains active, before entering an evidence lock-in stage. Consequently, fixed late-stage correction may alter the final readout without removing accumulated cue dependence. We therefore propose Evidence Reset, which selects an input-dependent layer before lock-in and reconstructs cue-aligned states toward their cue-free counterparts. Our results establish evidence withdrawability as a process-level dimension of classifier reliability and suggest a new intervention principle: correction depth should follow the dynamics of evidence rather than be fixed in advance.
papers.title_zh: 推理动力学：图像分类器在视觉线索被移除后仍在使用它
papers.summary_zh: 发现局部视觉线索移除后其影响仍分布在后层表示中，并提出追踪线索影响演化的框架。

papers.title: STAC++: Plug-and-Play Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Aware Cache Compression for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Streaming 3D reconstruction must preserve geometry under limited memory, yet STAC's fixed-resolution spatial key-value (KV) cache grows as scenes expand. We propose STAC++, a plug-and-play, training-free framework that compresses and reuses spatial memory for long-term reconstruction in unbounded scenes. Adaptive Spatial KV Cache (ASKC) organizes KV states into an octree with adaptive resolutions across regions and layers. Response-Aware Cache Compression (RACC) guides KV merging by measuring attention-output changes, balancing storage savings with geometric preservation. Temporal Context Refinement (TCR) reuses cached intermediate features and recomputes only a short backbone suffix to refine historical predictions with later observations. Integrated into four pretrained streaming backbones, STAC++ reduces spatial memory consumption while maintaining competitive reconstruction quality on long sequences and large scenes, with further quality gains from refinement at limited computational overhead. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
papers.title_zh: STAC++：面向流式 3D 重建的即插即用自适应时空感知缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 用八叉树自适应分辨率和响应感知合并，免训练压缩流式 3D 重建的空间 KV 缓存。

papers.title: ArgsWorld: Unifying 3DGS Scene Reconstruction, Generation and Extrapolation with Autoregressive Diffusion Transformer
papers.abstract: Autoregressive diffusion world models deliver strong video generation performance, yet they typically output only RGB frames rather than explicit 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scene representations, creating a gap between learned visual world dynamics and usable 3D assets for downstream robotics, simulation and rendering. To bridge this gap, we introduce ArgsWorld, an autoregressive diffusion model that also produces an explicit 3DGS scene. For each generation chunk, the diffusion transformer jointly processes clean historical image latents and noisy latents for new views. It keeps the historical image latents fixed and refreshes the scene features so that the Gaussian representation can be revised as new regions come into view. Our 3D Self-Forcing Distillation trains the model on its own generated histories using a mixture of single-view and multi-view data. Distribution matching supervises direct image latents and latents of Gaussian renderings at both generation and additional cameras. ArgsWorld unifies 3D scene reconstruction from posed images, scene generation from image or text prompts, and scene extrapolation across camera segments with disconnected endpoints. Experimental results demonstrate that ArgsWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple 3D scene modeling tasks. Project page: https://m4a1tastegood.github.io/ArgsWorld/
papers.title_zh: ArgsWorld：用自回归扩散 Transformer 统一 3DGS 场景重建、生成与外推
papers.summary_zh: 自回归扩散模型在生成视频的同时输出显式 3DGS 场景表示。

papers.title: DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings
papers.comment: 33 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB)
papers.abstract: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.
papers.title_zh: DiscernBench：评测 LLM 智能体在制度场景中的协作判断力
papers.summary_zh: 基于航空、执法等真实事故报告构建场景，评测智能体决定服从、拒绝或上报的能力。

papers.title: 3DCodeFactory: Scaling Training Data for 3D Code Agents
papers.abstract: As code agents evolve, their scope is expanding from generating simple static 3D meshes to constructing structurally complete, complex, interactive 3D scenes. However, existing datasets mainly rely on converting or captioning pre-existing 3D assets, consisting mostly of single-turn code data for static single objects and struggling to scale task diversity and scene complexity, leaving such training data scarce. We present 3DCodeFactory, an automated framework that directly constructs diverse, complex 3D training data from abundant raw text (e.g., diffusion prompts and product descriptions). The framework first leverages an image generator to synthesize 3D reference images from raw text as visual anchors, guiding the generation of concrete modeling specifications and interactive functional requirements; meanwhile, it jointly constructs visual, specification, and functional rubrics from the reference images and requirements to automatically score and filter multi-turn agent rollouts. Based on this framework, we release 3DCodeFactory-Data, comprising 5,045 high-quality task instances and multi-turn interaction trajectories. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B on 3DCodeFactory-Data significantly improves performance on BlenderWorld, P3D-Bench, and 3DCodeBench, consistently outperforming models trained on existing open-source 3D code datasets, with our 27B model further surpassing the same-series 2.4T flagship Qwen3.8-Max in overall performance.
papers.title_zh: 3DCodeFactory：为 3D 代码智能体扩展训练数据
papers.summary_zh: 从文本自动构造多样且复杂的交互式 3D 场景代码训练数据。

papers.title: Where Does a Weight-Editing Agent Help? Blind Diagnosis and Repair of Deployment Faults in Vision Models
papers.abstract: Language-model agents can read and edit the weights of neural networks without gradients, and this is increasingly presented as a new way of repairing models. We ask what such an agent adds, in a setting with a known answer. A vision model moved into a new system may be broken by a preprocessing, weight-conversion or output-convention fault; an agent restricted to forward passes must decide whether a fault exists, name it, and undo it by editing the weights. Over 183 runs on classification, segmentation and detection, scored against the fault-free model, we find three things. When the kind of fault is known, the agent is not needed: a script written afterwards repairs 30 of 48 faults against the agent's 33. But the agent did not have to be told: on five fault types outside every script it repairs 15 of 15 where that script repairs 4, and it never edits any of 21 fault-free models. And its limits are predictable: it needs a trustworthy per-layer reference for the model's activations and a fault that is an invertible structured transformation; without them, small faults are missed and repairs stay partial. We derive guidance on when to use an agent and when a script.
papers.title_zh: 权重编辑智能体在哪里有用？视觉模型部署故障的盲诊断与修复
papers.summary_zh: 在 183 次运行中检验智能体通过编辑权重诊断并修复视觉模型部署故障的能力。

papers.title: Imagine Smarter, Drive Faster: Efficient World Modeling for Decision-Aware Autonomous Driving
papers.comment: 23 pages total, 8 pages main text (4 figures, 8 tables), 12 pages supplementary material (9 figures, 5 tables)
papers.abstract: World models hold great promise for autonomous driving planning, yet their ability to imagine the future often comes at a formidable computational cost. Efficiency efforts, such as knowledge distillation and domain-specific pre-training, often shift this burden to costly teachers or training pipelines, leaving lightweight world modeling an open challenge. We introduce FastWorld, a natively lightweight world-model framework for efficient autonomous driving planning. FastWorld reduces computation through compact scene representations, short-horizon action-conditioned prediction, and selective candidate verification and score refinement. These designs support efficient future-informed planning without teacher distillation or additional domain-specific pre-training. On NAVSIMv1, FastWorld achieves 92.2 PDMS at 132 FPS on a single 4090 GPU. It also achieves 89.4 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2 and an average L2 of 0.40 over 3 seconds at 17 FPS on nuScenes. Code and models can be found at https://github.com/MoyangSensei/FastWorld.
papers.title_zh: 想得更巧，开得更快：面向决策感知自动驾驶的高效世界建模
papers.summary_zh: FastWorld 用紧凑场景表示和短时域动作条件预测，降低驾驶世界模型的计算量。

papers.title: Learning in the Passive Space: End-to-End Muti-Order Port-Hamiltonian Macromodeling
papers.abstract: Compact, passive state-space macromodels of interconnects and power-delivery networks are essential for stable transient signal- and power-integrity simulations. However, conventional flows require costly per-layout full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulations, while both traditional fitting and prior learning surrogates rely on post-hoc fitting or passivity perturbation that degrades accuracy without guaranteeing convergence. In this work, we propose an end-to-end macromodeling framework that learns directly in the passive space, mapping physical layout graphs to multi-order port-Hamiltonian (pH) macromodels. Specifically, our network encodes each layout graph into unconstrained matrix blocks and assembles them via a complete, prefix-nested pH parameterization that guarantees continuous-frequency passivity and stability by construction, yielding valid $k$-state macromodels via direct state slicing in one forward pass. To train all orders without reference realizations, we supervise the network directly on S-parameters through a progressive order-growth curriculum. Evaluated on 27k unseen test structures from a 270k-structure advanced-packaging dataset, our framework reduces mean S-parameter error by $42\%$ on average (up to $65\%$) over established macromodeling tools fitted to ground-truth EM responses, achieves zero passivity violations across $459{,}000$ exported models, and accelerates macromodel generation by $11{,}000$--$39{,}000\times$ ($36$--$85$~ms per layout).
papers.title_zh: 在无源空间中学习：端到端多阶端口哈密顿宏模型
papers.summary_zh: 直接从版图图学习多阶端口哈密顿宏模型，保证互连网络仿真的无源性。

papers.title: Pretraining Representation Lottery Determines Fine-tuning Generalization
papers.abstract: Large scale pretraining (PT) followed by fine-tuning (FT) is the central paradigm of modern deep learning, yet how PT shapes FT generalization remains poorly understood. We use a synthetic setup in which the ground-truth concept geometry of entities is known, as a controlled testbed to study how representational geometry affects model behavior and how PT representations determine FT generalization. We first show that models differing only in training seed can closely match in PT loss yet vary substantially in FT generalization. We hypothesize that a representational lottery underlies this phenomenon: the random seed dependent geometry formed during PT determines what FT can reach. We confirm this causally. First, injecting the ground-truth concept geometry into the model yields near-ceiling FT generalization, showing that good representations directly drive generalization. Then, distilling a lucky seed's learned representation into an unlucky seed unlocks FT generalization, while distilling the same model's behavior does not. Furthermore, representation distillation can merge entities that never interacted during PT, which FT alone cannot. Finally, we show that regularizing representational drift during FT enables naturalistic learning: only models with good representations learn the task, and they generalize, while models with poor representations fail to fit it. Under plain FT, by contrast, models with poor representations fit the training objective by reshaping their pretrained representations. We reproduce the distillation result in Pythia-160M and Pythia-410M, each pretrained multiple times with different random seeds, and show that the transferable representation lives in the deep layers at both scales. Overall, PT acts as a lottery over representations, and the representation a model draws determines how it adapts during FT in a way that behavior alone does not explain.
papers.title_zh: 预训练表征抽签决定微调泛化
papers.summary_zh: 在已知概念几何的合成设置中，显示预训练损失相近的不同种子微调泛化差异很大。

papers.title: AdapToC: A Unified Framework for Multi-Task Visual Token Communication
papers.abstract: Pretrained discrete visual tokenizers supply compact latents for synthesis, recognition, and embodied perception, yet wireless token streaming remains fragile. Under fading and noisy pilots, hard cyclic redundancy check (CRC) erasures turn corrupted blocks into missing tokens while frozen decoders amplify edge errors, which can collapse unequal error protection (UEP) into a binary choice between strong coding and omission under severe fading. Soft bit posteriors break this collapse. We present AdapToC, a single-pass transceiver that restores multi-tier rate-distortion tradeoffs without altering tokenizer weights or differentiating through pixel decoders. We align codebook geometry to the channel via offline frequency-weighted Pseudo-Gray relabeling and Halton dispersion to contract bit and burst errors with zero overhead. Because soft recovery pulls intermediate rates onto the three-tier convex hull, our unit-gated AdaLN sender schedules protection tiers across channel budgets, while our pilot-calibrated receiver feeds factorized codebook posteriors into a ConvNeXt-attention restorer with CRC bypass. We co-train AdapToC solely in latent space via counterfactual utility estimation and codebook cross-entropy regularization. On identical VQGAN-f16 tokens, AdapToC outperforms TONIC and adaptive TokenCom+AMC, cuts multi-SNR Rayleigh LPIPS from 0.6551 to 0.3312 within the frozen-tokenizer PSNR ceiling, and saves 43.8% Rician-K6 symbols at matched quality. Our single-pass restorer runs 8.3x faster than iterative resampling, raises accuracy while accelerating decoder-free recognition 20.6x, and improves fidelity plug-and-play across TiTok, VAR, and zero-shot NuPlan.
papers.title_zh: AdapToC：统一的多任务视觉 Token 通信框架
papers.summary_zh: 用软比特后验改进衰落信道下离散视觉 Token 的无线传输。

papers.title: A high-speed and high-resolution 3D velocity map imaging system with a neuromorphic camera
papers.abstract: An improved camera-based 3D-velocity map imaging (VMI) system was demonstrated with a neuromorphic camera. We show a machine vision event-driven camera can achieve an unprecedented latency of 2 microseconds when detecting single ion/electron with a microchannel plate imaging detector, which boosts the speed of the momentum imaging system to more than 100 kHz, while the system with a conventional frame camera is limited to a few kHz. The high spatial resolution of the camera offers additional performance boost while maintaining excellent multi-hit capability and a high time resolution.
papers.title_zh: 基于神经形态相机的高速高分辨率 3D 速度图成像系统
papers.summary_zh: 用事件相机探测单个离子或电子，延迟达 2 微秒，成像速度超过 100 kHz。

papers.title: JevNavAgent: A Single-Forward Visual Navigation Agent with Trajectory-Level RL for Gigapixel Pathology
papers.abstract: Gigapixel whole-slide images (WSIs) exceed single-pass vision-language model (VLM) capacity at cellular resolution, while multiple instance learning relies on query-agnostic offline patching without interactive reasoning. Multi-step VLM navigation agents inspect regions on demand, yet face two bottlenecks: (1) autoregressive action decoding incurs heavy latency, throttling exploration and online multi-trajectory RL; and (2) offline distillation suffers from an existential-versus-universal stopping asymmetry between positive detection and negative exclusion, inducing thumbnail and kinematic shortcuts while leaving policies prone to passing metastases without stopping. Under the Jev (System One) paradigm, a model predicts distributions over predefined decision spaces in one forward pass (0 generated tokens) while deterministic code executes navigation. We build JevNavAgent, a 2B-parameter agent combining factorized stopping, spatial-candidate, and contextual-bilinear answer heads with overview modality dropout. We pair Stage-1 offline counterfactual trajectory alignment (mitigating depth and panning shortcuts) with Stage-2 online trajectory-level GRPO (Traj-GRPO), using decoding-free rollouts to optimize branch-level lesion discovery, in-polygon stopping, and step-wise confidence gain. On Clean Visual WSI-VQA, JevNavAgent achieves 51.57% multi-scale (50.43% terminal-step) overall and 51.39% focal accuracy, outperforming frontier VLM agents and 4B-11B open-source cascades while running nearly 12x faster than frontier APIs (5.63s vs. 66.64-70.04s). On CAMELYON16 Official Test, Traj-GRPO reaches 22.45% localization (converting 11/12, or 91.7%, of visited tumors into grounded stops) with 93.75% specificity and 69.77% slide accuracy, surpassing Stage-1 SFT under matched stopping rules alongside zero-shot budget scaling.
papers.title_zh: JevNavAgent：面向吉像素病理的单次前向视觉导航智能体与轨迹级强化学习
papers.summary_zh: 用单次前向动作预测与轨迹级 RL，让 VLM 智能体在吉像素病理切片上按需导航。

papers.title: Contrastive Gradient Guidance for Test-Time Multi-Preference Alignment of Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Aligning pre-trained diffusion models with multiple context-dependent preferences requires adapting generation at test time rather than relying on offline fine-tuning, which requires hyperparameter tuning and a new training run for each preference trade-off. Existing approaches compress diverse preferences into a single scalar reward objective for fine-tuning or test-time guidance rather than directly reusing existing generative experts released for different purposes and obtained through different fine-tuning methods. In this work, we propose Contrastive Gradient Guidance (CGG), a test-time compositional generative framework that reformulates multi-preference alignment as a composition of distributions. CGG represents each preference as a contrastive preference pair of favored experts and unfavored anti-experts, whose score difference forms a contrastive gradient guidance signal that combines denoising directions (gradients) from off-the-shelf diffusion models during sampling. Experiments show that CGG reuses pre-trained and fine-tuned models as favored experts or anti-experts to control output style and safety, and that it can be combined with existing sampling-based reward guidance. With a single fixed scale per pair, CGG composes five preferences at once and gives a more balanced trade-off across text-image preference, concept control, photographic fidelity, and safety than offline fine-tuning, weight-space merging, and reward steering.
papers.title_zh: 扩散模型测试时多偏好对齐的对比梯度引导
papers.summary_zh: 在测试时复用多个现成生成专家，实现扩散模型的多偏好对齐而无需重新训练。

papers.title: Frozen by the Mean: Early Temporal Guidance Unfreezes Motion in Video Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Video diffusion models can render convincing frames while failing to produce the requested action. Increasing classifier-free guidance (CFG) can strengthen motion, but also saturates and shifts colors. Scalar CFG assigns the same coefficient to the averaged and frame-varying components of its prediction difference, limiting independent control of temporal variation. THAW, Temporal Harmonic Amplification during Warm-up, retains stock CFG and adds a separately weighted residual during an initial denoising window. Its dose specifies the added norm relative to the current CFG difference, giving the extra guidance a consistent relative budget across sampling steps. THAW is training-free and reuses CFG's two model predictions with an unchanged network evaluation count. It improves cost-matched motion over scalar and scheduled CFG on five video models, with positive point estimates against existing guidance methods on three of them. On VBench, THAW raises dynamic degree by about 14 to 15 points over stock CFG while increasing total scores on a different set of three models.
papers.title_zh: 被均值冻结：早期时间引导让视频扩散模型的运动活起来
papers.summary_zh: THAW 在 CFG 基础上对帧间变化分量单独加权，增强运动而不引起饱和与色偏。

papers.title: PSC-Gen: Physical Sequence Conditioning for Video Generation via Agentic Visual Planning
papers.abstract: Recent advances in video diffusion models have enabled the synthesis of high-fidelity, visually compelling videos. However, despite being trained on internet-scale video data, understanding underlying physical laws and generating physically plausible dynamics remain challenging. To mitigate this, conditioning video generators on explicit physical reasoning has emerged as a promising direction. Nevertheless, existing conditioning approaches often fail to incorporate detailed physical guidance into generation, resulting in physically implausible motion or visual artifacts. We propose PSC-Gen, a training-free framework that employs an agentic approach to synthesize visual conditions and inject their core dynamics via low-frequency filtering. By iteratively planning physical states and verifying generated keyframes, our Physics Agent constructs visually and physically consistent keyframe sequences. We then interpolate these keyframes into a continuous physical sequence and inject only its low-frequency components, steering the video model to preserve physical dynamics while synthesizing fine visual details. Qualitative and quantitative evaluations across physics-informed and robotic manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that PSC-Gen faithfully follows instructions and generates physically plausible videos.
papers.title_zh: PSC-Gen：基于智能体视觉规划的物理序列条件视频生成
papers.summary_zh: 用智能体视觉规划给出显式物理序列条件，使视频生成更符合物理规律。

papers.title: From Pairwise to Collective: Encoder Collections Make Unpaired Vision-Language Alignment Reliable
papers.abstract: Strong vision and text encoders can be trained independently, but their representations are not directly comparable. Connecting them usually requires paired image-text data, which may be unavailable. Unpaired alignment instead fits a map between a vision and a text encoder from feature-space geometry alone, enabling text-based retrieval and zero-shot classification without paired data. Treating each pair independently leads to fragile searches, repeated fitting, and uncertain map quality. A collection of encoders supplies additional supervision: all vision encoders embed the same images and all text encoders the same texts. Correspondences within each modality are therefore known exactly, while the cross-modal correspondence remains hidden. ConsensusAlign pools each modality into a shared space, fits one unpaired cross-modal bridge, and transfers it in closed form to every encoder pair. New encoders join through same-modality fitting without repeating the cross-modal search. On 21 vision-text encoder pairs and five seeds, pooled fitting aligns every pair, whereas pairwise fits fail in 68 of 105 pair-seed cells. Mean alignment error (FOSCTTM) falls from 0.1457 to 0.0099, and zero-shot accuracy nearly doubles on ten datasets. Gains persist across the tested within-modality pooling constructions with a WP bridge. New corpora reuse the bridge through native maps fitted to unlabeled target features from every source encoder. Agreement with separately fitted reference maps detects failures on COCO.
papers.title_zh: 从成对到集体：编码器集合使无配对视觉语言对齐更可靠
papers.summary_zh: 利用多个编码器的集合，从特征空间几何完成无配对图文对齐。

papers.title: Beyond Single-Turn Privacy: Training-Data Leakage in Conversational RAG
papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is known to reduce training-data leakage in single-turn interactions, but whether this protection persists over multi-turn conversations is unclear. We introduce CRELT (Conversational RAG Extraction Leakage Trajectory), a reusable framework that tracks, turn by turn, the real contact details from the training data that a RAG system discloses. CRELT separates retrieval, conversation history, and attack strategy through a full-factorial design, uses a retrieval corpus verified to contain none of the target PII, and counts an item as leaked only when it is absent from the model input at the turn it is produced. In our main experiment, this criterion excludes 29-53% of raw matches that were already present in the input. Across GPT-J-6B, Pythia-6.9B, and Pythia-12B, targeting real Enron contact details, retrieval reduces disclosure under both full and cleared history, consistent with prior single-turn results. A length-matched control with random passages reproduces 91-99.5% of this reduction under cleared history and 47-78% under full history, so much of it comes from the added context rather than from what is retrieved. With retrieval enabled, however, retaining full conversation history increases disclosure by a factor of 3.6-4.9, while retaining only one previous turn already restores disclosure to approximately the full-history level. With retrieval, clearing the history reduces disclosure by 72-79%, but does not eliminate it. These results show that single-turn privacy audits can substantially underestimate training-data leakage in conversational RAG systems and that conversation-history policy is a critical dimension of privacy evaluation.
papers.title_zh: 超越单轮隐私：对话式 RAG 中的训练数据泄露
papers.summary_zh: 提出 CRELT 框架，逐轮追踪对话式 RAG 泄露训练数据中真实联系方式的情况。

papers.title: UNIFY: Unified Learning with One Model via Batch Norm Switching
papers.abstract: Neural networks are typically trained separately for individual datasets or tasks, resulting in many task-specific models. This redundancy increases memory footprint, deployment costs, and energy consumption limiting their scalability. We propose UNIFY, a unified learning framework that enables a single model to jointly learn and perform inference across multiple datasets via Batch Normalization Switching (BNS). Instead of maintaining separate models for each dataset, UNIFY shares the parameter-intensive backbone while maintaining dataset-specific BN statistics and parameters, along with dataset-specific classification heads. We validate our framework using five datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet) across six Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) of different sizes (SqueezeNet 1.1, WideResNet-40-2, WideResNet-16-8, ResNet-18, ResNet-34, ResNet-50). Notably, a single UNIFIED ResNet-34 trained on these datasets achieves accuracies of 99.53%, 94.84%, 96.12%, 80.32%, and 67.67%, respectively, outperforming the average performance of the corresponding independently trained task-specific models while reducing the memory footprint by approximately 4.94x, from 428.30 MB (five separate models) to 86.71 MB (one unified model). UNIFY aims not only to consolidate (K) models into a single model but also to enhance model-effectiveness by leveraging complementary knowledge across datasets. It paves the way for scalable, efficient, and unified learning capable of handling diverse image classification tasks. Code is available at: https://github.com/saktx/UNIFY.
papers.title_zh: UNIFY：基于 Batch Norm 切换的单模型统一学习
papers.summary_zh: 通过切换 Batch Normalization，让单个模型同时学习并推理多个数据集。

papers.title: Multimodal LLMs Know the Game but Assume the Real World
papers.comment: 32 pages, 12 figures, 26 tables. Code: https://github.com/GaoJianXin05/RuleCraft ; data and model answers: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GGjx/RuleCraft
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models can state the rules of a video game, but do they apply them when they only see the game? We introduce RuleCraft, 1,240 image questions over 155 Minecraft rules with outcomes verified in the game engine, each asked in text, on the image with the game named, and on the bare image. Six widely used models know the rules and recognize the game, yet answer the bare image by real-world physics: naming the game raises their accuracy on rules where the game departs from reality by 8.2-19.8 points on a main set and by 33.8-52.7 on a hard stress-test set. Their errors pick the real-world outcome, the gap is largest where the game leaves a scene unchanged, and reasoning traces state the game's rule, then answer by reality. On the main set, naming the game mostly swaps the real-world default for the game's. The pattern holds with reasoning, recurs in two more games, and persists on questions the models themselves take to be about the game; one neutral sentence asking for the rules of the world shown recovers much of the gap. Evaluations that name the game measure knowledge of its rules, not world selection.
papers.title_zh: 多模态大模型懂游戏规则，却按现实世界作答
papers.summary_zh: RuleCraft 含 1240 道 Minecraft 规则图像题，发现模型对无游戏提示的图像按现实物理作答。

papers.title: Learning Optical Flow with Task-Oriented Feature Adaptation
papers.abstract: Learning-based optical flow estimation approaches generally rely on both inter-frame correspondence evidence and intra-frame contextual guidance, yet features from general-purpose image encoders may not fully support these roles. Strongly activated but weakly discriminative channels can outweigh more informative ones when computing inter-frame feature similarity, while context feature affinities can be low within motion-coherent regions yet high across motion boundaries. To address these mismatches, this study proposes TO-Flow, a task-oriented feature adaptation framework that aligns matching and context features with their respective requirements through dedicated channel modulation and spatial reorganization approaches. An affinity-based soft partition distinguishes motion-region interiors from boundary-adjacent regions to guide both processes. Channel modulation uses simulated flow refinement to assess whether each channel assigns higher similarity to estimated correspondences than to nearby competing candidates. The resulting similarity differences are aggregated within each region type and averaged across iterations to derive channel weights that emphasize informative channels and suppress ambiguous ones. Spatial reorganization combines affinity-guided feature attraction and repulsion from coarse to fine to simultaneously improve consistency within motion-coherent regions and distinctiveness across motion boundaries, with feature resampling mitigating boundary blurring during cross-scale fusion. Extensive experiments on the MPI Sintel, KITTI 2015, Spring, and LayeredFlow datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and general applicability of TO-Flow across diverse iterative refinement architectures as well as supervised and unsupervised training paradigms. The source code will be publicly available at https://mias.group/TO-Flow upon publication.
papers.title_zh: 基于任务导向特征适配的光流学习
papers.summary_zh: 对通用图像编码器特征做适配，使其更适合光流的帧间匹配与上下文引导。

papers.title: VEGA: A Scalable Software-Hardware Co-design for Genome Alignment using RVV Extension
papers.abstract: Dynamic programming (DP)-based genome sequence analysis is fundamental to computational genomics, but it remains computationally intensive as genomic data volumes continue to outpace Moore's Law. Existing hardware accelerators often sacrifice programmability and scalability across diverse alignment algorithms. In this work, we present VEGA, a scalable software-hardware co-design that accelerates genome alignment using RISC-V Vector extensions. VEGA introduces specialized vector instructions and three key innovations: a Forefront Stationary dataflow that minimizes off-chip memory access, intersequence parallelism that maximizes SIMD lane utilization, and custom ISA extensions that accelerate core alignment operations. Evaluations show that VEGA achieves up to 15.1x and 9.7x speedups for Edit Distance and Smith-Waterman algorithms over the Ara2-RVV vector baseline, sustaining 10.2x and 6.7x gains for 10kbp sequences. Post-synthesis results indicate only 1.0% area overhead compared to a standard RISC-V core, with performance-per-area efficiency rivaling specialized ASICs. VEGA thus achieves a balanced advancement in efficiency, programmability, and scalability for genome sequence alignment.
papers.title_zh: VEGA：基于 RVV 扩展的可扩展基因组比对软硬件协同设计
papers.summary_zh: 用 RISC-V 向量扩展加速基于动态规划的基因组比对。

papers.title: Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution for Cost-free Image Enhancement
papers.abstract: Image enhancement spans degradations with distinct spectral characteristics. Standard convolutions use fixed kernels, whereas dynamic convolutions gain adaptability at additional inference cost. We propose Dynamic Spectrum Re-parameterized Convolution (DSRC), a plug-and-play module that learns task-adaptive spectral responses during training while retaining standard convolution at inference. DSRC decomposes convolution kernels into frequency bands, applies learnable high/low-pass modulation, and incorporates lightweight residual branches. Owing to the linearity of these operations, all training-time components are analytically fused into a single kernel for inference. Experiments on low-light enhancement, underwater enhancement, and image super-resolution show consistent PSNR gains and generally improved or preserved SSIM and LPIPS across twelve backbone-task configurations, with unchanged deployed parameter counts and theoretical FLOPs, and no additional inference operators.
papers.title_zh: 面向零成本图像增强的动态频谱重参数化卷积
papers.summary_zh: 训练时学习频带自适应响应，推理时退化为标准卷积，不增加推理成本。

papers.title: Entangle: Scaling Human-Video In-Context World-Action Models across Unseen Tasks and Contexts
papers.comment: 26 pages, 13 figures, including the appendix. Project page at https://entangle-robotics.github.io/
papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two challenges: task-level human-robot pairs are not temporally aligned with robot actions, and standard action losses allow policies to rely on initial-scene or task-identity shortcuts rather than tracking the context. We present Entangle, an in-context world-action model that maps a single human video and current robot observations to future visual states and executable actions. To scale temporally aligned training data, we convert recorded robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation, supplemented by real paired recordings. For model training, we combine variable-length video windows with an intra-task contrastive objective that distinguishes the paired action trajectory from other executions of the same task, preventing task-identity shortcuts. Without task-specific fine-tuning, Entangle improves steadily as aligned training data scales, reaching an average score of 83.5/100 across six unseen tasks on an Astribot S1 robot, and achieves a 69.5% average success rate on seven unseen RoboTwin tasks, outperforming Zero-WAM by 22.6 percentage points. Under Context-OOD, although trained only on scene-aligned pairs, Entangle transfers context-specified behaviors across rearranged layouts and substituted tools. Project page at https://entangle-robotics.github.io/
papers.title_zh: Entangle：跨未见任务与场景扩展人类视频上下文世界动作模型
papers.summary_zh: 用人类视频作为上下文，让世界动作模型在机器人操作中完成未见任务。

papers.title: Seeing Is Not Planning: Spatiotemporal Planning and Plan Repair in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Planning in a visual world means reading the layout, foreseeing how the state will change, and following the task rules all at once. When a plan fails, a model should also use what went wrong to fix it. We call these two abilities spatiotemporal planning and plan repair, and test them with Railbound-Bench. A model sees a railway puzzle, adds tracks under a budget, and submits one complete layout; a simulator then moves all cars at once and decides whether the layout works. After a failure, the model sees what happened and may submit a new layout, up to five attempts in total. On the 200-puzzle main set, the best of nine models solves 59.5% within five attempts, the next 39.5%, and the other seven at most 10.0%; a 1,000-puzzle extended set with a wider range of difficulty is far easier, at 90.9% for the best model. Controlled studies on 180 fixed puzzles show that knowing the task is not the same as using it. GPT-6.1 Terra copies 97.2% of boards exactly and, given a correct layout as text, predicts all four requested future states in 91.3% of cases, yet only 22.8% of its first layouts work. Planning fails more often as the cars' routes interact, even among puzzles that a search solver finds equally easy. Visual feedback removes the reported fault in 175 of 417 first revisions, but only 43 of these revisions solve the puzzle, and at an equal budget of 40k tokens it does no better than fresh retries. The code and data are open-sourced on GitHub at https://github.com/liaoyanqing666/Railbound_Bench.
papers.title_zh: 看见不等于规划：多模态大模型的时空规划与计划修复
papers.summary_zh: 用铁轨拼图 Railbound-Bench 测试多模态大模型的视觉时空规划与失败后修复能力。

papers.title: AERIN: Aerial Instance Navigation with a Visual World Model
papers.abstract: Searching from high altitude and navigating to a target instance specified by a reference image is a common application for UAVs. In such tasks, high-altitude observations provide broad ground coverage for efficient search, but targets occupy fewer pixels, making instance verification and action selection more difficult. We present AERIN, a visual world model that uses action-conditioned prediction to guide the UAV toward the target while adjusting its viewpoint to obtain higherquality observations for subsequent instance verification. Highaltitude navigation requires fine-grained target details and scene context relevant to visibility, but repeatedly predicting dense visual representations of this information is computationally expensive. AERIN addresses this challenge with a compact, fixedsize, target-conditioned latent state that separately represents both for efficient action evaluation. Experiments demonstrate that AERIN outperforms the evaluated baselines in target approach and observation quality, while requiring substantially less decision time than similar world models.
papers.title_zh: AERIN：基于视觉世界模型的空中实例导航
papers.summary_zh: 用动作条件预测的视觉世界模型引导无人机飞向参考图像指定的目标实例。

papers.title: KMed-31B Technical Report
papers.abstract: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD$^2$). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.
papers.title_zh: KMed-31B 技术报告
papers.summary_zh: 基于开源权重后训练的 31B 医疗大模型，面向有限硬件的本地部署。

papers.title: ReCoRain: Reliability-Coupled Content and Noise Conditioning for Event-Guided Video Deraining
papers.abstract: Event-guided video deraining depends on reliable cross-frame correspondences, yet events generated by scene motion, rain, and sensor noise can provide ambiguous matching evidence. In diffusion-based restoration, an incorrect match can transfer unrelated content and correlate initial noise between unrelated scene locations. We propose ReCoRain, an event-guided residual video diffusion framework that couples temporal content transfer and noise correlation through a common assessment of correspondence reliability. This assessment combines RGB appearance, interval-event evidence, and forward-backward motion consistency. The content path aggregates neighboring features according to alignment reliability, while the noise path uses composed backward motion fields and their associated reliability estimates to regulate initial-noise sharing across the latent sequence. We use the same conditional noise construction during residual flow-matching training and inference, incorporating temporal noise coordination into the learned restoration process. Temporal supervision matches motion-compensated inter-frame differences in restored and clean videos under the same teacher-estimated flow and visibility mask, accommodating legitimate appearance changes. ReCoRain achieves 32.09 dB PSNR on NTURain-Syn and 28.73 dB on RainSynLight25. Enabling reliability gates in both paths reduces warping error by 33.0% relative to disabling both gates.
papers.title_zh: ReCoRain：面向事件引导视频去雨的可靠性耦合内容与噪声条件
papers.summary_zh: 用统一可靠性评估耦合时间内容迁移与噪声相关，改进事件引导的扩散式视频去雨。

papers.title: DynFlux: Learning to Dynamically Balance Consensus and Conflict in Multimodal Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition remains challenging due to the intrinsic heterogeneity of different modalities. Effectively leveraging both cross-modal consensus (consistency) and conflict (inconsistency) is essential, as they jointly provide complementary cues that enhance emotion understanding from diverse perspectives. Traditional multimodal methods often suffer from semantic ambiguity and rarely explicitly model the interplay between cross-modal consensus and conflict. Moreover, existing approaches struggle to capture and exploit the dynamic interactions between these two complementary factors. To overcome these limitations, we propose DynFlux, a model guided by a temporal heterogeneous graph that encodes both consensus and conflict relationships across modalities. DynFlux introduces a dedicated graph branch that explicitly captures cross-modal dependencies through sparse temporal graphs, and modulates the conventional multimodal emotion recognition pipeline at three hierarchical stages: adaptive feature modulation during feature extraction, guided aggregation modulation during feature integration, and fusion strategy modulation at the multimodal fusion stage. Through this design, DynFlux dynamically balances cross-modal consensus and conflict, enabling richer and more robust emotion understanding. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets confirm that DynFlux consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, and its generality is further validated on multimodal intent recognition and multimodal sarcasm detection tasks.
papers.title_zh: DynFlux：多模态情感识别中动态平衡一致与冲突
papers.summary_zh: 显式建模跨模态一致与冲突并动态平衡，用于多模态情感识别。

papers.title: Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game
papers.comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Pre-registered protocol (v1-v5, all amendments committed before the games they govern). Engine, benchmark harness, agents and protocol: https://github.com/federicolucca/hexfolk, tag bench-v1. Companion to arXiv:2610.32955 and arXiv:2611.21393. No frontier model; paid pairings limited to 50 games by budget
papers.abstract: Measure Before You Train argued that an agent's decisions should be measured against ground truth, under a protocol fixed in advance, before anyone trains or replaces the model behind them. We carry the method to a second, very different domain, a turn-based strategy game, and ask a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play under a pre-registered protocol? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for this purpose, so no model has seen its rules or positions. A deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs make every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games, on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals. Two small open language models (8B and 3B) lose every game to a few-line rule player. Answering in free text they are invalid on 98% of their decisions; constrained to legal moves they never play an invalid one, yet they lose to the uniformly random player (the 8B model wins 10.0 [4.3, 21.4]% of games), refuting our expectation that they would beat it; the result survives a control that shuffles the order of the options. Two native decision models never play an invalid move and both beat random; one loses all 50 games to the rule player, the other is not distinguishable from it in 50 games and beats a one-step search. The paid agents make tens to over a hundred model calls per game; against the same opponents a free 60 ms-per-move search, which makes none, outplays every paid model by the full range of the scale. Two 7-8B models served locally behave the same way. No frontier model is included.
papers.title_zh: 合法不等于好：低成本语言与决策模型在新策略游戏上的预注册基准
papers.summary_zh: 在自编 4X 游戏 hexfolk 上按预注册协议评测低成本智能体的对局表现。

papers.title: Domain-Specific Self-Supervised Learning for Cuneiform Sign Representation
papers.comment: Accepted at the VisionDocs Workshop at WACV 2027
papers.abstract: Recognizing cuneiform signs is challenging: sign shapes vary across historical periods, scribal practices, and preservation conditions, while expert annotations are scarce. We study whether domain-specific self-supervised pretraining yields better cuneiform sign representations than generic natural-image pretraining. We pretrain a masked autoencoder, CuneiMAE, on over 900K unlabeled sign crops and compare it with ImageNet-pretrained MAE, CLIP, and DINOv2 on a 218-class sign recognition benchmark. CuneiMAE learns substantially stronger frozen representations (43.7% linear-probe accuracy vs. 25.2% for ImageNet-MAE), with gains over ImageNet-MAE on cross-period transfer. Under fine-tuning, CuneiMAE outperforms ImageNet-pretrained baselines on our internal benchmark, with the largest gains when labels are scarce (+20.4 pp over ImageNet-MAE with 1% of labels). On an external benchmark, CuneiMAE reaches 69.9% top-1 accuracy after fine-tuning, about 8 pp above the ResNet-18 baseline from prior work. Explicit structural priors, such as edge-guided masking and part bottlenecks, do not improve over standard masked reconstruction. Overall, domain-specific self-supervision shows strong performance on cuneiform recognition tasks, particularly when labels are limited.
papers.title_zh: 面向楔形文字符号表示的领域自监督学习
papers.summary_zh: 在 90 万楔形文字符号裁剪图上预训练 CuneiMAE，对比 ImageNet MAE、CLIP 与 DINOv2。

papers.title: When Local Semantics Disagree: Learning to Detect Fake News through Weakly Supervised Cross-Modal Reasoning
papers.abstract: The rapid proliferation of multimodal social media content has made fake news detection a pressing challenge for the vision-language community. Most existing approaches rely on coarse global similarity between text and images, which overlooks subtle, uneven cross-modal inconsistencies -- such as sentiment-scene mismatches, object-level manipulations, or semantic dissonance between visual and textual cues. Moreover, these models treat all inconsistencies as equally informative, ignoring domain-specific variation in how such conflicts manifest, which limits both generalization and interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose DMIL, a dual-branch multiple instance learning framework that formulates multimodal fake news detection as a weakly supervised learning problem. Each news article is treated as a bag of visual and textual instances processed through two complementary branches: an embedding-space branch that aggregates global semantics via expert-guided modality fusion, and an instance-space branch that models cross-modal inconsistencies across local-to-global granularities. A retrieval-augmented, domain-adaptive router further contextualizes inconsistencies using retrieved domain exemplars and dynamically fuses multi-level cues. Extensive experiments on public misinformation benchmarks demonstrate that DMIL achieves competitive state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong discriminative capability against fake news across different domains.
papers.title_zh: 当局部语义不一致：基于弱监督跨模态推理的假新闻检测
papers.summary_zh: 通过弱监督建模图文局部语义不一致，检测多模态社交媒体假新闻。

papers.title: CoopOcc: Cooperative 3D Semantic Occupancy Perception via Multi-Agent and Cross-Modal Fusion
papers.abstract: Semantic occupancy perception has emerged as a promising paradigm for jointly modeling 3D scene geometry and semantic information. However, this unified representation cannot compensate for missing information caused by occlusion and sensor coverage. Multi-agent cooperation alleviates this limitation, but information from different agents is not equally useful across spatial regions. Meanwhile, feature representations from each agent form the basis of reliable multi-agent fusion. Cross?modal fusion constructs such representations by integrating complementary semantic and geometric information. Despite this complementarity, jointly establishing reliable 3D correspondence across agents and preserving modality-specific structures remains challenging. To address these limitations, we propose CoopOcc, which performs cooperative 3D semantic occupancy perception through multi-agent and cross-modal fusion. CoopOcc uses ego?query cross-agent attention (EQCA) to selectively aggregate aligned features across agents, and anchor-based bidirectional feature interaction (ABFI) for cross-modal exchange at matched coordinates. We further construct SemanticVVSim, a simulation dataset, and establish a unified benchmark. For simulation-to-real transfer, we propose confidence-aware hierarchical occupancy and relational distillation (CHORD). CoopOcc performs best overall among ten evaluated methods on SemanticVVSim. On Occ3D-nuScenes, CHORD improves performance using knowledge from SemanticVVSim. The code is available at https://github.com/LOTEAT/CoopOcc.
papers.title_zh: CoopOcc：基于多智能体与跨模态融合的协同 3D 语义占据感知
papers.summary_zh: 融合多智能体与多模态信息，补偿遮挡造成的 3D 语义占据缺失。

papers.title: SkillLens: An Interactive Human-LLM System for Diagnosing and Refining Agent Skills
papers.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet maintaining them requires developers to connect revisions with changes in behavior and task outcomes. Existing workflows fragment evidence across versions, evaluation cases, and execution traces. We present SkillLens, an interactive human-LLM system for diagnosing and refining agent skills. A formative study with five developers and researchers identified challenges in prioritizing failures, reconstructing case-level evidence, and preserving context across revisions. SkillLens links performance changes, case transitions, skill diffs, invocation sequences, traces, and outputs in a recoverable workflow, while keeping model-generated explanations and refinements under human review. Through a between-subjects user study with 20 participants, we show that SkillLens supports developers in diagnosing and refining agent skills through a more usable and less demanding workflow than the baseline. These findings highlight the value of linking version comparisons, case-level evidence, and human-reviewed refinement across skill iterations.
papers.title_zh: SkillLens：诊断与改进智能体技能的人机交互系统
papers.summary_zh: 把技能修订、评测用例和执行轨迹关联起来，帮助开发者诊断并改进智能体技能。

papers.title: HiPerfCC-KVCache: Accelerating Confidential LLM Serving with Hierarchical KV Caching
papers.abstract: Hierarchical key-value (KV) caching reduces repeated prefill computation in large language model serving by retaining reusable state beyond GPU memory. Under GPU confidential computing (CC), however, protected transfers can erase this benefit. We show that bulk KV copies hold driver locks during prolonged CPU-side processing, stalling independent serving operations despite separate threads and streams. Our characterization on Hopper and Blackwell GPUs shows how lock scope, copy granularity, and allocation ownership affect foreground progress and transfer parallelism. Guided by these findings, we present HiPerfCC-KVCache, which manages resource lifetimes, prioritizes ready token readback between bounded backup submissions, and parallelizes KV restores through auxiliary contexts with shared GPU staging. Implemented in SGLang, HiPerfCC-KVCache uses existing protected transfer interfaces without hardware or driver changes. Across three models and three workloads on H200, HiPerfCC-KVCache achieves a geometric-mean output-token throughput speedup of $1.74\times$ (up to $2.72\times$) over the staged KV-transfer HiCache-Workers baseline at the highest tested loads. Mean time to first token decreases by 36% on average and up to 59%. The benefits generalize to RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, with a geometric-mean throughput speedup of $1.28\times$ (up to $2.20\times$) over the same baseline. A capacity analysis further models and explains variation in gains and remaining gaps to CC-off serving.
papers.title_zh: HiPerfCC-KVCache：用分层 KV 缓存加速机密 LLM 服务
papers.summary_zh: 在 Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU 机密计算下，解决批量 KV 拷贝持锁导致的服务停顿。

papers.title: PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL: Polarization-Keyed Examination Papers and Mandatory Issued Eyewear that Displace AI Glasses and Extend Universal Design
papers.comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Framework, optical analysis, simulation study (Mueller-calculus page model, capture/OCR leakage experiment, metamerism test with 151 observers and 28 cameras), and evaluation protocol; no physical or human-subject results. Companion to arXiv:2611.26033 (SEOYUN). Simulation code in anc/
papers.abstract: Camera-equipped AI glasses turn an examination page into a query for a remote vision-language model. Device detection targets possession, and our companion work SEOYUN targets the model. PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL instead changes who owns the eyewear. Every candidate wears authority-issued glasses for the whole session, and the question paper is printed so that it can be read only through them. As in cinema stereoscopy, a patterned laminate encodes the text in the handedness of circular polarization rather than in brightness. The page looks uniformly grey to the naked eye and to unfiltered cameras, and the issued circular analyzer reveals the text. Compulsory issued eyewear turns the smart-glasses form factor against itself. The face position is occupied by a device the authority supplies and collects, and a camera anywhere else needs its own analyzer. Spectacle wearers receive prescription inserts in the issued frame, low-vision candidates may use an offline assistive mixed-reality tier, and blind candidates keep braille, audio, and screen-reader formats. We derive the luminance and contrast budget and show why circular keying tolerates head tilt. A simulation study supports the analysis. A spectral Mueller model confirms tilt invariance and invisibility to linear-polarization cameras, but a 1 degree axis misregistration leaks a few percent of contrast. A capture-and-OCR experiment on English and Korean text shows that video averaging can recover leakage too weak to read in a single frame, so leakage must be bounded against the adversary's total photon budget. Data from 151 observers and 28 cameras show that spectral (metameric) keys are visible to all of them. The key carries no secrecy, and filtered covert cameras remain possible. All results are simulations; no prototypes, physical measurements, or human-subject results are reported.
papers.title_zh: PEACE-TEST-PROTOCOL：偏振密钥试卷与强制发放眼镜以取代 AI 眼镜
papers.summary_zh: 用圆偏振编码试卷文字，只有考场统一发放的眼镜才能读取，防止 AI 眼镜作弊。

papers.title: Can Your AI Twin Meet People for You? It Can Hold a Conversation. But What Does It Need to Judge Like You?
papers.abstract: Should your AI twin go meet people on your behalf? We built LLM twins of 710 real people from their other conversations in the CANDOR corpus, sent them to meet each other in 5,680 simulated first conversations, and checked every rehearsal against what the real people said after meeting for real (355 held-out, participant-disjoint pairs, against baselines that include each person's rating history). The rehearsals work: a twin's conversation predicts real liking ($ρ$=0.277), carries information that questionnaires and rating history do not have (partial $ρ$=0.16 [0.05, 0.26]), and recovers most of what the same reader gets from the real conversation (0.321). Swap controls show that this signal travels through the conversation, not through the persona card. What, then, does a twin need to judge like you? Not your voice: making twins talk more like their owners, with person-specific activation steering and a LoRA trained on their own speech, did not help in a pre-specified test and lowered accuracy in an exploratory second round (-0.183 [-0.294, -0.066]). Nor simply your stated ratings: a persona-prompted twin that holds the conversation does not yet carry its owner's judgment, and when told its owner's past ratings it anchors on them instead of weighing them. Learning helps: a small appraisal head trained on other real conversations, which combines the twin's post-call answers with its owner's rating history, lifts rehearsal-based prediction above the history baseline out of fold (+0.059 [0.001, 0.115], against +0.022 without the twin's answers; pre-specified primary contrast +0.056 [-0.001, 0.111]). We propose an attribution protocol for twin-based social simulation and identify learned appraisal as the component twins need next.
papers.title_zh: 你的 AI 分身能替你见人吗？它能聊天，但要像你一样判断还缺什么
papers.summary_zh: 用 710 人的对话构建 LLM 分身，在 5680 场模拟首次对话中预测真实见面后的好感。

papers.title: QUISA: A Compact, Flexible and Unified Instruction-Set Coprocessor for QR-UOV Signature
papers.abstract: QR-UOV is a Quotient Ring Unbalanced Oil and Vinegar (UOV) multivariate quadratic (MQ) signature scheme that has progressed to round-3 of the post-quantum cryptography (PQC) additional signatures call by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). Until now, for architectural efficiency and performance trade-offs, QR-UOV has been evaluated only on software platforms and has never been considered on hardware, such as field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs). To address this, we are the first to provide a complete QR-UOV hardware implementation through a flexible and unified QUISA coprocessor design, which supports instruction-driven execution for key generation, signing, and verification across all three NIST security levels (SL-I, SL-III, SL-V). The proposed architecture features extensive throughput optimizations by parallelizing key QR-UOV module operations, such as the pseudorandom byte generator, hashing, and rejection sampling. To minimize hardware resources, we propose a modular arithmetic unit with finite-field reduction based on the shift-add folding method. The design introduces a linear system solver for QUISA based on LU decomposition with partial pivoting and a sample solution module, operating over the prime field Fq (q = 127). We comprehensively evaluate QUISA on an Artix-7 FPGA at 80 MHz up to the post-place-and-route stage, utilizing 11,144 slices and 35,248 look-up tables. For higher SL-V security levels, it completes key generation, signing, and verification in 30.4M, 3.8M, and 2.8M clock cycles, respectively.
papers.title_zh: QUISA：面向 QR-UOV 签名的紧凑灵活统一指令集协处理器
papers.summary_zh: 首次在 FPGA 上实现 QR-UOV 后量子签名的指令集协处理器。

papers.title: PopMelodyGen: A Copyright-Aware Platform for Controllable Pop-Melody Generation
papers.comment: AAAI 2027 Demonstration Program (accepted); extended version with appendix
papers.abstract: Large-scale redistributable symbolic pop-melody data remain scarce due to copyright restrictions, creating a bottleneck for both practical deployment and reproducible research in music generation. We present PopMelodyGen, a copyright-aware platform for controllable pop-melody generation that combines rule-based synthesis with neural generation. Our approach first uses an expert synthesizer to produce large-scale labeled synthetic melodies from explicit musical knowledge and templates, providing scalable pretraining data with auditable provenance. A neural model is then pretrained on this corpus and adapted with a small licensed real-pop corpus to improve melodic naturalness while preserving controllability. The platform supports interactive melody creation with accompaniment playback and export for creators, as well as batch construction of annotated symbolic datasets for researchers. PopMelodyGen demonstrates a practical training and deployment paradigm for creative AI when large-scale reusable real-world data are limited.
papers.title_zh: PopMelodyGen：版权友好的可控流行旋律生成平台
papers.summary_zh: 结合规则合成与神经生成，在避免版权问题的前提下实现可控流行旋律生成。

papers.title: DeCo: Decoupled Traffic State Modeling with Cross-Variable Coordination
papers.abstract: Accurate forecasts of traffic flow, occupancy, and speed are essential for congestion management and travel planning. These variables exhibit distinct spatiotemporal patterns, and their coupled dynamics characterize the evolution of traffic conditions, such as the onset and dissipation of congestion. Existing methods often either neglect this coupling or struggle to capture the distinct dynamics of all three variables within a unified model. In this paper, we propose DeCo, a decoupled traffic state modeling framework with cross-variable coordination for forecasting flow, occupancy, and speed. Specifically, DeCo first trains a dedicated forecaster for each variable to specialize in its unique spatiotemporal dynamics. It then estimates a residual correction for each forecast by jointly leveraging the predicted trajectories and recent observations of all three variables, thereby exploiting cross-variable coupling and mitigating systematic prediction errors. We extend the flow-only PeMS03 and PeMS07 benchmarks to all three variables on their original sensors and release the aligned data. Experiments on PeMS03, PeMS04, PeMS07, and PeMS08 show that DeCo achieves the lowest mean absolute error for every variable on every dataset, up to 4.9% below RAGC, the strongest baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/lixus7/DeCo.
papers.title_zh: DeCo：带跨变量协调的解耦交通状态建模
papers.summary_zh: 分别建模交通流量、占有率和速度的时空模式并协调其耦合，用于交通预测。

papers.title: Rethinking Visual Token Retention in Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract: Autoregressive Large Vision-Language Models solve multimodal reasoning tasks by retaining hundreds or thousands of visual tokens, allowing every generated token to attend to the visual tokens at any time during the generation process. However, whether continuous access to these visual tokens is necessary remains poorly understood. In this work, we investigate how visual token influence evolves along two dimensions: generation time and transformer depth. Using long-form visual reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, we first analyze the attention dynamics across generation time and transformer depth. We identify a temporal and depth-wise structure in the use of visual information. Visual attention peaks during the initial generation steps and then rapidly declines as attention shifts toward previously generated reasoning tokens. Across depth, visual influence is concentrated in intermediate layers and becomes very weak in the final layers. We further verify these observations with causal intervention that removes all visual tokens across generation time and model depth. These interventions confirm that visual-token dependence in multimodal reasoning is neither temporally persistent nor uniformly distributed across transformer depth. Thus, retaining the complete visual context at every layer and decoding step may be unnecessary. Our experiments demonstrate that we can remove up to 59\% of tokens from the full input prompt across generation time and 11\% across all transformer layers, while incurring only a very small performance drop. On video benchmarks, up to 65\% of the input prompt tokens can be removed during generation without affecting performance.
papers.title_zh: 重新思考多模态推理中的视觉 Token 保留
papers.summary_zh: 研究视觉 Token 影响随生成时间和网络深度的变化，检验持续访问视觉 Token 是否必要。

papers.title: CHORD: Closed-loop Human-Object Rectified-flow Decomposition
papers.abstract: Text-driven 3D human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires synthesizing whole-body human and object motions that stay coupled through contact. Yet existing generators either entangle the core variables that govern an interaction (object pose, contacting regions, and limb posture) with dozens of subordinate joints, or plan only end-effectors or coarse trajectories. No stage of generation holds the interaction in a form that is both settled and observed, which leaves contact to external guidance, post-hoc refiners, or internal guidance without a surface measurement. We present CHORD, a two-stage rectified-flow framework that settles the interaction in a compact plan and observes that plan against the object surface while it is being generated. First, Draft uses twelve part tokens per temporal patch to jointly plan the 6-DoF object trajectory, contact states, and the end and middle joints of every kinematic chain. At each flow step, Draft decodes the expected interaction from the closed-form clean estimate, measures it against the object surface, and routes this feedback to the responsible part token with zero extra network evaluations. Second, Full keeps this plan unchanged and infills the remaining body and finger joints. On InterAct, CHORD reduces FID by 33% and lifts hand contact F1 from 0.730 to 0.834, while its feedback improves contact on unseen objects and transfers plug-and-play to existing HOI generators.
papers.title_zh: CHORD：闭环人物体矫正流分解
papers.summary_zh: 用矫正流分解关键交互变量，生成文本驱动的 3D 人与物体交互运动。

papers.title: Improving the Improver: Semantic PID Control for Medical Agent Self-Improvement
papers.comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Dexia Chen, YiLong Hu, Wenqi Zhong, and Guangyu Guo contributed equally. Corresponding author: Zhongwei Qiu
papers.abstract: High-stakes vertical medical tasks, such as postoperative pathological staging and long-term survival prediction, demand multi-step clinical reasoning over heterogeneous evidence under weak supervision and high outcome uncertainty. While we first orchestrate CliAgent, a domain-tailored clinical agent workflow that systematically grounds predictions in multi-modal patient evidence, manually designed medical agents remain constrained by static, brittle rules. Moreover, existing recursive self-improvement (RSI) methods suffer from feedback ambiguity and severe development-set overfitting when evolving agents in high-noise medical domains. Focusing on improving the improver, we propose Semantic PID-RSI, an evidence-guided control-theoretic framework for medical agent self-improvement. Inspired by PID control, our improver evaluates candidate modification batches via three diagnostic roles: P isolates current clinical failure modes, I synthesizes longitudinal evidence from past trials, and D estimates response dynamics and regression risks (D-pre/D-post). Selected plans are compiled into behavior contracts for staged probing and independent adoption judging. Instantiated and validated on challenging oncology tasks (pT/pN staging and survival prognosis), evolving CliAgent with Semantic PID-RSI on a 3B-activated open-weight model achieves substantial gains (up to +6.27 C-index points), outperforming overfitting-prone RSI baselines and approaching the performance of frontier proprietary models (e.g., GPT-6 series) equipped with CliAgent.
papers.title_zh: 改进改进者：用于医疗智能体自我改进的语义 PID 控制
papers.summary_zh: 在术后病理分期与生存预测任务上，用语义 PID 控制让医疗智能体自我改进。

papers.title: ViewAgent3D: A Training-Free Multi-View Pipeline for 3D Scene Understanding
papers.abstract: 3D scene understanding tasks are often approached by building explicit 3D scene representations or by training specialized multi-modal models over point clouds, voxels, or scene graphs. We take a complementary view: for many queries, the main bottleneck is not the absence of a stronger 3D representation but the selection of a small subset of multi-view RGB views that actually makes the query answerable. We present a training-free, query-conditioned multi-view pipeline that performs diverse tasks using only 2D images and a set of tools used purely for inference. Our method first decomposes each query into a set of concepts that identify unique attributes that assist with reasoning. This drives a coarse-to-fine evidence selection process: a coarse retrieval selects and scores all views, a diversity-aware selector reduces redundancy, and a reranking stage helps shortlist views by target visibility or answerability. The resulting evidence is optionally grounded for queries that benefit from explicit localization, and a self-verification step helps refine the final response, especially for open-ended cases. Despite using no task-specific training and no explicit 3D representations at inference time, our approach provides approximately 10% gain on 3D VQA and 5% gain on dense captioning and Embodied QA while being applicable across different scenarios. We further propose a unique judge-based evaluation system, motivating a judge who takes into account many semantically correct or partially correct answers, thereby improving holistic scene understanding.
papers.title_zh: ViewAgent3D：免训练的多视角 3D 场景理解流程
papers.summary_zh: 按查询选出少量能回答问题的多视角 RGB 图，无需训练即可做 3D 场景理解。

papers.title: The Evaluation Substrate Matters: Benchmarking Multi-Agent Serving Substrates
papers.comment: Code: https://github.com/MAS-Sys-Bench/MAS-Sys ; Project page: https://mas-sys-bench.github.io/MAS-Sys-Page/ ; Trace dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MAS-Sys/MAS-Sys-Traces
papers.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) usually coordinate heterogeneous models and tools to solve complex tasks, creating a growing need for reliable evaluation. However, a multi-agent workflow that is fastest in one serving environment can lose its advantage in another, even when its models, prompts, and task remain fixed. This makes a benchmark result conditional on how the workflow is executed. We introduce MASSys, a benchmark for measuring this dependence in multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems. MASSys executes the same candidate-task pairs across serving substrates and load regimes, using five workload families spanning software repair, research synthesis, financial analysis, interactive control, and diagram generation. It records task quality alongside delivery, latency, cost, resource pressure, and failure evidence. In a controlled motivation diagnostic, the Star workflow falls from first to fourth in mean-latency rank under KV-cache pressure, while Chain rises from fourth to first. The substrate sweeps further show that increasing load creates long runtime tails and timeout pressure. In several task families, quality among evaluated outputs changes less than effective quality over submitted jobs: the system delivers fewer usable results even when the surviving outputs remain competitive. Tool and runtime traces reveal that these outcomes involve both model serving and non-model execution. Together, the results motivate evaluating MAS designs over explicit operating conditions and reporting which tasks are delivered, how well they are solved, and where execution breaks down.
papers.title_zh: 评测载体很重要：多智能体服务载体基准
papers.summary_zh: MASSys 衡量同一多智能体工作流在不同服务环境下性能表现的差异。

papers.title: Learning Continuous Scene Depth Representations via Cross-Modal Gaussian Rendering
papers.abstract: Depth super-resolution with color guidance is a fundamental problem in geometric scene understanding that aims to reconstruct high-resolution depth using structural cues from color images. In practical RGB-D systems, the resolution gap between depth and color images often varies, requiring flexible upsampling factors. However, many existing methods are designed for predefined integer scales. Although implicit methods support arbitrary-scale reconstruction, they typically rely on computationally demanding per-pixel neural decoding and may struggle to recover sharp depth boundaries and fine structures. To this end, we propose a cross-modal Gaussian rendering framework that learns continuous depth representations for arbitrary-scale depth super-resolution. Specifically, we first construct hierarchical Gaussian representations for progressive depth reconstruction, with explicit spatial support defined by learnable Gaussian primitives. Building on this representation, we design a Structure-Aware Gaussian Aggregation module that combines spatial weights with cross-modal feature affinities to reduce aggregation across depth discontinuities. We then develop a Scale-Adaptive Gaussian Rendering module that adapts Gaussian spatial kernels to the target pixel footprint. To further facilitate cross-modal learning, we propose a training strategy that gradually introduces higher-frequency guidance information during training. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method at both in-distribution and out-of-distribution upsampling scales.
papers.title_zh: 通过跨模态高斯渲染学习连续场景深度表示
papers.summary_zh: 用高斯渲染做彩色引导的任意倍率深度超分辨率。

papers.title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
papers.comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Information appended. Code and data: https://github.com/acodercat/AtmosRegime
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.
papers.title_zh: 物理状态切换暴露大模型的公式误用
papers.summary_zh: 受控实验显示 LLM 常在公式适用域之外套用公式，并检验后训练能否缓解。

papers.title: When to Test, Repair, or Regenerate: Decision-Guided Efficient RTL Generation
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can generate register-transfer-level (RTL) designs from natural-language specifications. To improve functional correctness, many RTL agents use simulation feedback to guide refinement. However, without a reference testbench, generating one for every initial implementation incurs inference cost even when the RTL is correct. We therefore introduce an adaptive harness that uses a specialized decision model to orchestrate testing, refinement, and candidate selection. It accepts high-scoring initial implementations and generates testbenches for the rest. When further search is needed, the initial score guides repair--regeneration allocation, while defect rankings and simulation feedback guide repair. For final selection, the harness prioritizes test-passing candidates and ranks them using decision-model scores. Across three benchmarks, the harness with DeepSeek improves mean Pass@1 by 5.4--7.1 percentage points over initial implementations and reduces aggregate estimated inference cost by 11.0--14.3% relative to a testbench-guided repair baseline with the same candidate cap.
papers.title_zh: 何时测试、修复还是重新生成：决策引导的高效 RTL 生成
papers.summary_zh: 用决策模型调度测试、修复与重新生成，减少无参考测试平台时的 RTL 生成开销。

papers.title: RecallWorld: Episodic Memory for Persistent Embodied Video World Models
papers.abstract: Video world models generate plausible novel views but often lack persistent memory, failing to preserve a place's geometry and appearance when an agent revisits a scene. A central challenge is how previous views should be effectively used for creating memory. Reconstructing them independently underutilizes geometric constraints between nearby views, while repeatedly reconstructing a growing history can propagate later prediction errors into earlier geometry. We introduce RecallWorld, a persistent embodied video world model that jointly reconstructs short multi-view episodes into Scenelets while keeping geometry independent across episodes. Starting from a single source image, camera-aware ray lifting places perspective and native fisheye images in a common world frame, retaining wide-field content for perspective generation. Each generated segment extends the Scenelet memory and conditions subsequent generation. Coverage-based retrieval selects complementary Scenelets from the full history, while target-view visibility is resolved geometrically before appearance fusion, providing consistent memory conditioning for guiding subsequent generation.
